content: {"action":"plan","payload_json":"[{\"requirement_id\":\"req-revenue-query\",\"description\":\"Microsoft total company revenue (consolidated) for FY2025 (year ended 2025-06-30) and FY2024 (year ended 2024-06-30), with units, periods and accounting basis preserved.\",\"kind\":\"query\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\",\"query\":{\"records\":[{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2024-07-01\",\"end\":\"2025-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"},{\"entity_id\":\"sec-0000789019\",\"metric_id\":\"revenue\",\"period\":{\"kind\":\"year\",\"start\":\"2023-07-01\",\"end\":\"2024-06-30\",\"basis\":\"source\"},\"value_kind\":\"actual\"}]}},{\"requirement_id\":\"req-revenue-source\",\"description\":\"Original Microsoft FY2025 10-K income statement blocks (Item 8 heading, INCOME STATEMENTS heading, table with unit line, Year Ended June 30 period headings and Total revenue row for 2025 and 2024), plus any original wording stating the consolidated or US GAAP basis, for verifying total revenue.\",\"kind\":\"source_evidence\",\"source_id\":\"msft-2025-10k\"}]","reason":"Plan numeric query for FY2025/FY2024 total revenue and original source-body evidence from the income statement, addressing prior review feedback with a compact, non-redundant package.","requirement_ids":[]}
